title: Capstone Backend AI Project
description: Combine RAG, MCP, and agent patterns into one production-oriented .NET backend project with tests and documentation.

blocks.text: This capstone ties together the major themes of the course: terminology, RAG, MCP, agents, and production patterns. Build a backend that ingests documents, exposes MCP tools and resources, and answers user questions with a grounded, auditable AI service.

blocks.title: Expected deliverables
items: **Ingestion API** — accepts documents, chunks them, and stores embeddings.
**RAG endpoint** — answers questions with retrieved citations.
**MCP server** — exposes tools and resources for AI clients.
**Agent workflow** — plans and executes a multi-step backend task.
**Production controls** — logging, metrics, caching, safety filters, and tests.

blocks.title: High-level components
items: Background worker for document ingestion and embedding.
MCP server hosted alongside the API.
Integration tests for retrieval, MCP tools, and agent behavior.

blocks.title: Start with the simplest version
blocks.text: A minimal end-to-end prototype with one document type, one tool, and one agent is better than an unfinished grand design.

items.text: I can ingest and query documents through a RAG endpoint
items.hint: Upload, chunk, embed, store, retrieve, and generate with citations

items.text: My MCP server exposes tools and resources
items.hint: Use real backend services and validate inputs

items.text: My agent completes a multi-step task
items.hint: Use planning, tools, and memory without human intervention for safe tasks

items.text: I have tests, logs, and metrics
items.hint: Integration tests and observability for retrieval, tools, and agent loops

blocks.title: Course Summary
points: You learned AI terminology, RAG architecture, and popular .NET libraries.
You explored MCP as an AI-native backend interface.
You built agents with planning, memory, and human-in-the-loop controls.
You added production controls for safety, cost, observability, and deployment.
blocks.takeaway: You now have the vocabulary, libraries, patterns, and production mindset to build AI-powered .NET backends.
